integrity: The packaged verifier regenerates the complete finite domain and checks the census by two independent exhaustive enumeration paths; no randomized or tolerance-based computation is used.
scientific_limitations: Finite classification for binary length five only; the declared order-four group is not asserted to be the full automorphism group. An obscure or poorly indexed historical equality enumeration cannot be excluded.
title: Complete equality census for binary length-five comma-free codes
